Read a description of a situation. Then write an e-mail about the situation. You will have 9 minutes. You should aim to write at 50-120 words. Write using complete sentences.
ITEM TEXT

has
invited
you
to
watch
a
movie
with
her
on
Tuesday
evening
,
but
you
can't
go
that
time
.
Write
a
letter
to
explain
why
you
can't
go
.
You
should
write
between
80
and
120
words
.
You
should
include
:
1
.
Thank
for
her
invitation
;
2
.
Apologize
for
it
;
3
.
Suggest
another
time
to
go
.
